columns.name: income_k
columns.description: average income per inhabitant per month

columns.name: num_male_customer_edu_level_4_and_below
columns.description: The number of male customers with a level of education of 4 and below in the place, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_education_level
columns.description: The average education level of the inhabitants in the place.

columns.name: per_elderly_customer_never_married
columns.description: The percentage of elderly customers in the location who have never been married, out of all customers in that location. Elderly customers refers to age over 65.

columns.name: response_rate
columns.description: The proportion of mails sent to customers in the place that received a response, expressed as a value in the range [0, 1].

columns.name: per_male_teenager_among_all_teenage_edu_above_10
columns.description: The percentage of male teenagers with an education level above 10 among all teenagers with an education level above 10.
